version.approval_notes: No build step, no minified code. Source: https://github.com/ultimatecoder/neet2leet. The extension sends the NeetCode problem title to leetcode.com/graphql (questionList search) and, as a fallback, fetches neetcode.io's public page and main JS bundle to read NeetCode's own slug mapping.

summary.en-US: Adds an "Open on LeetCode" button to NeetCode problem pages that opens the matching LeetCode problem in a new tab.

description.en-US:
Follow the NeetCode roadmap but solve on LeetCode? neet2leet adds a button next to the problem title on every NeetCode problem page. It finds the matching LeetCode problem automatically (exact title search on LeetCode, with NeetCode's own problem mapping as a fallback) and opens it in a new tab.

No tracking or analytics. Found links are cached locally.
